title: Safely reuse Gatsby build output in CI
description: Test Anth.us Gatsby CI cache reuse and content changes without stale SSR/page-data mismatches; implement only a validated workflow and record build timing and route verification.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented the cache experiment and a CI consistency guard. The output guard checks every homepage recent-post slug and excerpt against Gatsby static-query data before caching/deploying. Local production-build timings with reused .cache/public: warm unchanged 15.86s; added post 20.96s; updated same slug 19.39s; removal 19.74s; homepage same-slug update check: 18.97s; removal 18.73s. Added/updated/deleted post route, posts-list page-data, homepage SSR, and homepage static-query results remained consistent with no stale fixture after removal. Rule-based guard passes current output and rejects a deliberately stale excerpt fixture. Initial local build processed 653 sharp jobs in 243s. Cache warm speedup is proven locally; Actions restore/upload overhead still needs measurement on the first GitHub run.
